subject.title: feat(dashboard): persist MCP Apps as board widgets

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this persistent MCP App board-descriptor and transcript-reminting contract, including the instance/revision/grant checks that govern restored interactivity?
rationale: The patch is an additive feature rather than a repair: it creates a durable stored representation and public Gateway API for a previously transient MCP App view, so code review alone cannot choose the intended product and security boundary.

options.title: Approve the durable contract
options.body: Accept the server-derived descriptor and reminting model, then land after exact-head required CI is green.

options.title: Narrow the authority contract
options.body: Require a revised descriptor or authorization model before merge if owners want stronger or differently scoped restoration semantics.

options.title: Defer durable MCP App widgets
options.body: Pause this backend feature and keep the existing transient-view model until the dashboard roadmap explicitly sponsors persistence.

recommendation.title: Approve the durable contract
recommendation.body: Accept the server-derived descriptor and reminting model, then land after exact-head required CI is green.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged dashboard stitching work and its stated remaining MCP App pinning scope make this the strongest feature-history routing candidate.
